limitations: This is obtained Linux 1.14.9 bundle metadata, not a Typora 1.14.10 baseline.
A label present in translation metadata may be historical, a group or value rather than a setting, hidden, or for another platform; it does not establish a current Linux UI option.
Category and candidate role are analyst organization, not configuration-key mappings or runtime facts.
All runtime defaults, value types and UI applicability for label candidates remain unknown. Only advancedDeclaredDefaults reports literal declarative values.
The declared null font values select unobserved engine fallbacks; do not replace them with assumed effective fonts.
Candidate list is deliberately selected and incomplete; it must not be called an exhaustive settings inventory.
The original translation files, help text, themes and program implementation are not copied into the Moye project.
Reference UI/runtime capture remains blocked; see typora-reference-report.json.
